title: DevSecOps & Cloud Security
description: Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines. Learn SAST/DAST, Container Vulnerability Scanning (Trivy), Secrets Management (Vault), OWASP Top 10 API Security, and Zero Trust.
objectives: Implement SAST (Static Application Security Testing) and DAST
Scan Docker images for CVEs using Trivy
Prevent secrets leakage in Git repositories
Understand OWASP Top 10 API Security risks
